items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Now when I, when I recorded my first number for Leonard Chess on the checker recording.

ctx.x: So the cane cutters evolved from your name Sugar Bowl?

Now when I, when I recorded my first number for Leonard Chess on the checker recording. And he, he put the name Sugar Boy on the record and he wanted to name the band. So he just put cane cutters to go along with the Sugar Boy. So he, he wrote a little article in the magazine, say that the name came by me. I was, I was born in the country, raised up in the country. And, and I got the nickname because I used to eat sugarcane.
